headline: Senate bill on women's reproductive freedom did not advance after a failed vote to move it forward in July 2024.
what_it_does: This bill was titled the Reproductive Freedom for Women Act and dealt with health policy. No official summary is available, so its exact provisions cannot be described here. Based on its title, it would have addressed reproductive rights for women. On July 10, 2024, the Senate did not vote to take it up or end debate, so it did not pass.

who_it_affects.how: Based on its title, the bill would have addressed women's reproductive rights, but the specific effects are not stated in the available material.
